responsibility: Defines the host_hooks implementation for running GCC itself on Darwin/powerpc hosts, with its central job being extra signal handling for stack-overflow and segmentation-fault diagnosis. It installs an alternate signal stack and a SIGSEGV handler that inspects the faulting PowerPC instruction to distinguish true crashes from stack-limit faults in prologue-style stores, then emits GCC diagnostics and shell-specific advice rather than leaving the compiler to die with an unhelpful host signal.
